passages.title: A Day at the Beach
passages.text: Last Saturday, Maria and her friend Tom went to the beach. The weather was sunny and warm. They took a big bag with towels, sunscreen, and sandwiches. When they arrived, they found a nice place near the water. Maria put on sunscreen because the sun was strong. Tom went swimming first. The water was cool and clean. After swimming, they ate their sandwiches and drank some juice. Then they played with a ball on the sand. Later, they walked along the shore and collected shells. They saw a small crab near a rock. Maria took a photo of it. At five o'clock, they packed their things and went home. They were tired but happy. On the way home, Tom said, 'I love the beach.' Maria agreed and said, 'Let's come again next weekend.' They both smiled. It was a perfect day.
